raw:
@s1 stated
  relation "have a call with"
  role subject "the user"
  role object "the client from Hamburg"
  role time "tomorrow at 10"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s2 stated
  relation "have a valid VIES code"
  role subject "the client from Hamburg"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@q query
  where match
    relation "be issued with reverse charge"
    role subject "the invoice for consulting services"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q2 query
  where match
    relation "be issued with"
    role subject "the invoice for consulting services"
    role object "21 percent VAT"
    polarity affirmed
  end
